title: Repair package-owned contents with independent verification
goal: Distinguish rpm -V flags, package-owned digest state and expected application output; reinstall exact local archive.
challenge: Repair the prepared damaged package-owned data 2.0-1 file without changing configuration or unrelated packages. Retain the failed verification, prove restored expected bytes against the supplied SHA-256 and preserved original, and actually read it as learner. Do not merely hide rpm -V output or regenerate a checksum from the damaged file.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-integrity.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-integrity.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: here && sudo "$h" apply data1 && sudo "$h" apply upgrade && fresh "$w/verify-before.txt" && rpm -V ll-rpm-data > verify-before.txt && test ! -s verify-before.txt && fresh "$w/original-data.txt" && cp /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt original-data.txt
steps.explanation: Use only supported operations: data1 then upgrade. Preserve clean package-owned bytes independently.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; test -f /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt && test ! -L /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt && test "$(realpath -e /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm)" = /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt)" = root:root:644:1 && fresh "$w/verify-damaged.txt" || return 19; printf "%s\n" damaged | sudo tee /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt >/dev/null || return 19; if rpm -V ll-rpm-data > verify-damaged.txt; then return 1; else test $? = 1 && grep -F /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt verify-damaged.txt; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: Change only the approved regular payload and retain actual RPM verification output. A learner-generated checksum alone is different evidence.

steps.command: here && sudo "$h" preview reinstall && sudo "$h" apply reinstall && fresh "$w/verify-after.txt" && rpm -V ll-rpm-data > verify-after.txt && test ! -s verify-after.txt && cmp original-data.txt /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt && test "$(sha256sum /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt | cut -d " " -f1)" = efcc5782abc5684c58caca66d0f23fbf64bc72109e4f937575ff834bb7c1cac4 && cat /usr/share/learning-lab-rpm/data.txt
steps.explanation: Reinstall the exact admitted archive and prove independent byte recovery plus actual learner read access.
steps.expected: Correct content/access and clean package verification.

hints: Listing files or a successful reinstall does not prove content/access; configured files may legitimately differ and need policy.
Read supported helper operations and the exact plan before APPLY. Unsigned fixture digests do not prove publisher authenticity.
Verify versions, payload/config bytes and actual learner access; package exit status alone is insufficient.
review: I retained the requested actual output, statuses, versions and byte/access evidence, including the incorrect case.
I met the selected mode’s outcomes and can explain the limitations. Completion records self-review, not a score or verified assessment.
I preserved originals and retained candidates, compared unrelated package state and completed only the exact cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5 102.5 integrity/reinstall. DNF4 awareness, not original YUM, DNF5 or Zypper proficiency. No complete-objective or LPI endorsement claim.
